spacing.rule: Generous, comfortable vertical rhythms. Cards are never flush to the screen edge (always at least md margin). Use Safe Area meticulously.

do's: Sticky headers over scrolling product grids
Sticky primary CTA container at the bottom of the cart screen

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure distinct navigation stacks for the three roles (Admin, Lojista/Vendor, Cliente/Customer) right after Google Auth resolves.
Implement the 'Gradient-to-dark Scrim Pattern' on the Customer Store Catalog header and the Auth Hero image to guarantee text readability.
Use standard Phosphor icons with consistent weights (e.g., regular/outlined) across the app, avoiding emoji altogether in system UI.
For the Vendor Dashboard, prioritize clear, highly visible action buttons on order cards ('Aceitar', 'Pronto') to support fast mobile workflows as per research.
For Customer Cart, group items clearly by Vendor with subtotals before the grand total, and pin the 'Finalizar Pedido' CTA to the bottom using a glass container.
Handle images robustly: always apply `expo-image` with contentFit='cover' for banners and use initials avatars (with `brandTertiary` bg) ONLY as fallbacks if store/user logos are missing.
